<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
  id="Definitions_collab" targetNamespace="urn:repr-werkbank:examples">
  <collaboration id="Collab">
    <participant id="Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_customer"/>
    <participant id="Shop" name="Web shop" processRef="Process_shop"/>
    <participant id="Bank" name="Bank"/>
    <messageFlow id="Msg_order" name="Order" sourceRef="SendOrder" targetRef="ReceiveOrder"/>
    <messageFlow id="Msg_confirm" name="Confirmation" sourceRef="Confirm" targetRef="Await"/>
    <messageFlow id="Msg_pay" name="Payment request" sourceRef="Charge" targetRef="Bank"/>
  </collaboration>
  <process id="Process_customer" name="Customer">
    <startEvent id="Need" name="Need arises">
      <messageEventDefinition/>
    </startEvent>
    <sendTask id="SendOrder" name="Send order"/>
    <eventBasedGateway id="Race"/>
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="Await" name="Confirmation arrives">
      <messageEventDefinition/>
    </intermediateCatchEvent>
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="Timeout" name="14 days">
      <timerEventDefinition/>
    </intermediateCatchEvent>
    <endEvent id="Happy" name="Order placed"/>
    <endEvent id="Failed" name="Escalated">
      <escalationEventDefinition/>
    </endEvent>
    <sequenceFlow id="C1" sourceRef="Need" targetRef="SendOrder"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="C2" sourceRef="SendOrder" targetRef="Race"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="C3" sourceRef="Race" targetRef="Await"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="C4" sourceRef="Race" targetRef="Timeout"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="C5" sourceRef="Await" targetRef="Happy"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="C6" sourceRef="Timeout" targetRef="Failed"/>
  </process>
  <process id="Process_shop" name="Web shop">
    <laneSet id="Lanes">
      <lane id="Sales" name="Sales">
        <flowNodeRef>ReceiveOrder</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>InStock</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>Confirm</flowNodeRef>
      </lane>
      <lane id="Billing" name="Billing">
        <flowNodeRef>Charge</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>Settled</flowNodeRef>
        <childLaneSet id="BillingSub">
          <lane id="Dunning" name="Dunning">
            <flowNodeRef>Remind</flowNodeRef>
          </lane>
        </childLaneSet>
      </lane>
    </laneSet>
    <receiveTask id="ReceiveOrder" name="Receive order"/>
    <inclusiveGateway id="InStock" name="Items available?" default="S_no"/>
    <manualTask id="Confirm" name="Confirm to customer"/>
    <businessRuleTask id="Charge" name="Charge customer"/>
    <intermediateThrowEvent id="Settled" name="Payment settled">
      <signalEventDefinition/>
    </intermediateThrowEvent>
    <task id="Remind" name="Send reminder"/>
    <endEvent id="Cancelled" name="Order cancelled">
      <errorEventDefinition/>
    </endEvent>
    <endEvent id="Fulfilled" name="Order fulfilled"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="S1" sourceRef="ReceiveOrder" targetRef="InStock"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="S_yes" name="yes" sourceRef="InStock" targetRef="Confirm">
      <conditionExpression>stock >= quantity</conditionExpression>
    </sequenceFlow>
    <sequenceFlow id="S_no" name="no" sourceRef="InStock" targetRef="Cancelled"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="S2" sourceRef="Confirm" targetRef="Charge"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="S3" sourceRef="Charge" targetRef="Settled"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="S4" sourceRef="Settled" targetRef="Fulfilled"/>
    <sequenceFlow sourceRef="Charge" targetRef="Remind"/>
    <sequenceFlow sourceRef="Remind" targetRef="Charge"/>
  </process>
</definitions>

flowchart LR
    Customer[["Customer"]]
    Shop[["Web shop"]]
    Bank[["Bank"]]
    Need(("Need arises"))
    SendOrder("Send order")
    Race{{ }}
    Await(["Confirmation arrives"])
    Timeout(["14 days"])
    Happy((("Order placed")))
    Failed((("Escalated")))
    ReceiveOrder("Receive order")
    InStock{{"Items available?"}}
    Confirm("Confirm to customer")
    Charge("Charge customer")
    Settled(["Payment settled"])
    Remind["Send reminder"]
    Cancelled((("Order cancelled")))
    Fulfilled((("Order fulfilled")))
    SendOrder -.->|"Order"| ReceiveOrder
    Confirm -.->|"Confirmation"| Await
    Charge -.->|"Payment request"| Bank
    Need --> SendOrder
    SendOrder --> Race
    Race --> Await
    Race --> Timeout
    Await --> Happy
    Timeout --> Failed
    ReceiveOrder --> InStock
    InStock -->|"yes"| Confirm
    InStock ==>|"no"| Cancelled
    Confirm --> Charge
    Charge --> Settled
    Settled --> Fulfilled
    Charge --> Remind
    Remind --> Charge

There is a participant named "Customer", referred to below as participant 1, executing process 1.
There is a participant named "Web shop", referred to below as participant 2, executing process 2.
There is a participant named "Bank". It receives a message flow from "Charge customer".
There is a process named "Customer", referred to below as process 1.
There is a start event named "Need arises", located inside process 1, with the event definition message. It is followed by "Send order".
There is a send task named "Send order", located inside process 1. It is preceded by "Need arises"; it is followed by event-based gateway 1; it sends a message flow to "Receive order" (message named "Order").
There is an event-based gateway without a name, referred to below as event-based gateway 1, located inside process 1. It is preceded by "Send order"; it is followed by "Confirmation arrives" and "14 days".
There is an intermediate catch event named "Confirmation arrives", located inside process 1, with the event definition message. It is preceded by event-based gateway 1; it is followed by "Order placed"; it receives a message flow from "Confirm to customer".
There is an intermediate catch event named "14 days", located inside process 1, with the event definition timer. It is preceded by event-based gateway 1; it is followed by "Escalated".
There is an end event named "Order placed", located inside process 1. It is preceded by "Confirmation arrives".
There is an end event named "Escalated", located inside process 1, with the event definition escalation. It is preceded by "14 days".
There is a process named "Web shop", referred to below as process 2.
There is a lane named "Sales", located inside process 2. It contains "Receive order", "Items available?" and "Confirm to customer".
There is a lane named "Billing", located inside process 2. It contains "Charge customer" and "Payment settled".
There is a lane named "Dunning", located inside "Billing". It contains "Send reminder".
There is a receive task named "Receive order", located inside process 2. It is followed by "Items available?"; it receives a message flow from "Send order".
There is an inclusive gateway named "Items available?", located inside process 2. It is preceded by "Receive order"; it is followed by "Confirm to customer" (flow named "yes", condition "stock >= quantity") and "Order cancelled" (flow named "no", default flow).
There is a manual task named "Confirm to customer", located inside process 2. It is preceded by "Items available?"; it is followed by "Charge customer"; it sends a message flow to "Confirmation arrives" (message named "Confirmation").
There is a business rule task named "Charge customer", located inside process 2. It is preceded by "Confirm to customer" and "Send reminder"; it is followed by "Payment settled" and "Send reminder"; it sends a message flow to "Bank" (message named "Payment request").
There is an intermediate throw event named "Payment settled", located inside process 2, with the event definition signal. It is preceded by "Charge customer"; it is followed by "Order fulfilled".
There is a task named "Send reminder", located inside process 2. It is preceded by "Charge customer"; it is followed by "Charge customer".
There is an end event named "Order cancelled", located inside process 2, with the event definition error. It is preceded by "Items available?".
There is an end event named "Order fulfilled", located inside process 2. It is preceded by "Payment settled".
